작업 마무리되면 [Image #1] @"C:\Users\user\Downloads\다운로드 (10).jfif" @"C:\Users\user\Downloads\다운로드 (6).jfif" @"C:\Users\user\Downloads\다운로드 (5).jfif"  이사진을 분석한 그림체의 캐릭터로 만들어서 측면모습@"C:\Users\user\Downloads\다운로드 (11).jfif" 이사진처럼 측면샷과 [Image #2] 이사진처럼 정면샷구도로 총 8장의 이미지를 생성해야한다.
이때 바꿔야하는 이미지 캐릭터의 구성요소들 머리색 복장 장비등등 구성을 지니고 있어야하며 키와 비율이 남성형 여성형이냐에 따라 구분되어야지 바꿔야하는 이미지 캐릭터캐릭터 개성을 따라가면안된다 이해됬는지?
<image name=[Image #1] path="C:\Users\user\Downloads\Gemini_Generated_Image_9njmlt9njmlt9njm (1).png">
</image>
<image name=[Image #2] path="C:\Users\user\AppData\Roaming\orca\agent-session-attachments\9a231920-659f-42b4-8a7c-73fc8163536c\orca-paste-1793957564707-09523ee1-417e-436a-b501-fa7e9e4298a1.png">
</image>

네. **원본에서는 디자인 구성요소를 가져오고, 그림체와 인체는 분석한 자료의 남성형·여성형 기준으로 새로 만드는 작업**입니다.

- **대상 4종:** Image #1, 다운로드 (10), (6), (5).
- **유지:** 머리색·헤어 구성·복장·색 조합·문양·장식·무기·방패 등.
- **새로 적용:** 얼굴 표현과 키·머리 크기·어깨·허리·팔다리 비율. 원본 특유의 얼굴형이나 SD·유아형 비율을 따라가지 않습니다.
- **총 8장:** 캐릭터마다 정면 전신 1장＋측면 전신 1장. 두 이미지의 디자인과 체형은 동일하게 유지합니다.

구도도 확인했습니다. **다운로드 (11)은 완전한 90도 옆모습이 아니라 사선 3/4 전신 구도**이므로 그 각도를 따르고, 정면은 Image #2처럼 머리부터 발끝까지 보이는 안정된 입상 구도를 따릅니다. 두 예시에서는 구도만 가져옵니다.

**기분 탓이 아닙니다.** 제가 만든 채팅 비교창은 **256×384 JPEG 축소본**이라, 확대하면 선과 얼굴이 뭉개집니다. 확대 버튼도 이 축소본을 키워 보여줬습니다.

저장된 원본은 **1024×1536 PNG**로 더 선명합니다. 다만 원본도 크게 확대하면 얼굴·장식의 세부 표현에는 한계가 있습니다.

[원본 PNG로 확인하기](<C:/Users/user/orca/workspaces/Grid Defenders/캐릭터디자인2/output/character-redesign-6x2/images/c06_front.png>) — 100% 배율에서 확인하시면 됩니다.

순서를 c1-1 ~ c6-2까지라고 한다면 

c2-1 2-2
c3-1 3-2
c4-1 4-2
c5-1 c5-2
c6-1 c6-2
는 작업이 잘된편이고
특히 c4는 독보적으로 잘된케이스
그다음으로는 c3인데
나머지는 그럭저럭인데
문제는c1 아직 특유의 AI느낌을 가지고있고 금속표현이 아쉬워
c4는 캐릭터 얼굴표현이 잘됨 다만 금속표현도 잘했지만
c3가 금속표현이 엄청 잘된케이스
멀리서보면 괜찮을수 있으나 가까이에서 봤을때도 괜찮을수있도록 약간의 수정이 필요할것같아 해당 피드백후 c1다시 구성해봐

네. **같은 캐릭터를 네 방향에서 보여주는 전신 턴어라운드**입니다.

1. **정면 — 0°**
2. **정측면 — 90°**, 완전히 옆을 보는 모습
3. **후면 — 180°**
4. **3/4 사선 — 약 45°**, 앞서 제작한 구도

네 방향에서 **얼굴·머리·복장·장비·체형을 일치**시키고, 키·머리 크기·발바닥 기준선도 맞춥니다. 비대칭 장비는 실제 착용한 좌우를 유지하며, 뒤쪽 구조도 앞면과 자연스럽게 이어지도록 구성합니다.

그림체는 계속 **C4의 얼굴 표현＋C3의 금속 표현**을 기준으로 적용합니다.

**「GC9 캐릭터 그림체 기준」, 버전 `GC9 v1.1`**로 저장했습니다.

- [그림체 규칙](<C:/Users/user/orca/workspaces/Grid Defenders/캐릭터디자인2/문서/02_세부기획/02_영웅/캐릭터그림체/GC9_그림체기준.md>)
- [캐릭터 생성 프롬프트](<C:/Users/user/orca/workspaces/Grid Defenders/캐릭터디자인2/문서/02_세부기획/02_영웅/캐릭터그림체/GC9_생성프롬프트.md>)

**C4 얼굴 표현·C3 금속 표현**을 우선하는 피드백도 포함되어 있습니다.

스플래시 배경은 **SP13 v1.0**으로 따로 정리했습니다. [13장 분석·8유형 분류](<C:/Users/user/orca/workspaces/Grid Defenders/캐릭터디자인2/자료/스플래시아트/SP13/분석리포트.html>) · [스플래시 프롬프트 양식](<C:/Users/user/orca/workspaces/Grid Defenders/캐릭터디자인2/문서/02_세부기획/02_영웅/스플래시아트/SP13_생성프롬프트.md>)

투구로 얼굴을 완전히 가리고, 오른손 검·왼손 방패의 위치를 고정하겠습니다. 성기사의 인상은 장비와 실루엣으로 표현하며, 속성은 요청하신 대로 **무속성**으로 두겠습니다.

먼저 시안 1장을 만드는 순서는 [캐릭터 제작 규약](<C:/Users/user/orca/workspaces/Grid Defenders/캐릭터디자인2/문서/02_세부기획/02_영웅/캐릭터제작규약.md>)의 “일러스트 시안 1장을 제작한다. 사용자의 명시적인 통과를 기다린다”는 기존 지시를 따른 것입니다. 이번 최종 방향은 요청대로 앞·옆·뒤 3장으로 기록하겠습니다.

successful_recipes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE polished 2D anime fantasy-game ADULT FEMALE archer, straight-on FRONT full-body neutral view, portrait 2:3 preferably 1024x1536.
Input 1 = SOURCE DESIGN COMPONENTS ONLY: silver-haired blue/silver armored archer. Do not copy source 1's individual face, anatomy, action pose or rendering. Input 2 = Edel PRIMARY DRAWING STYLE, clean face simplification and cel-shaded form. Input 3 = Bram MATERIAL reference for coherent silver plate construction only, not his male body or costume. Input 4 = FRONT COMPOSITION ONLY; do not copy her blonde hair, floral pin or robe.
Use the shared STANDARD ADULT FEMALE anatomy: about 7.5 heads tall, small normal adult anime head, long legs, narrower shoulders and lighter torso than a male, regular hands. Her new clean game-anime face has clear blue irises, defined upper eyelids, small nose/mouth, calm focused expression. Keep anatomy and facial rendering in the target standard rather than the source character's particular age impression or height.
KEEP INVENTORY FROM IMAGE 1: long pale silver/white hair tied into a high sweeping ponytail with saturated cobalt-blue ribbons/strands. Dark blue/black pointed feather/flower-like hair ornament and small white frilled hair accessory. Cool silver full armor with layered raised shoulder plates, silver forearm guards/gauntlets, a dark charcoal and white fitted torso, white/silver plate panels over the thighs and lower legs, cobalt/navy hip cloth and short layered white ruffled underskirt/trim. Navy-and-white draped back/hip panels with delicate geometric decoration. One dark cool-silver recurve bow with thin taut string and small cyan accents; preserve the source bow's narrow angular limbs and blue/white palette, not a gold/green bow. Keep the differentiated silver metal, white frill and dark blue cloth. NO extra shield, sword or quiver not present in source.
RENDERING: match input 2's fine crisp anime linework and large separated cel-shaded planes; logical metal plate overlaps and selective sharp highlights like input 3, broad matte fabric shadows, soft skin, large tapered hair locks. Avoid painterly realism, 3D metallic phototexture, overly glossy skin, thick sticker outline, excessive microengraving or huge magical glow.
FRONT: face, shoulder line, torso, hips and knees square to camera. Stable two-foot standing posture like input 4. Arms relaxed and slightly apart, one hand holds the un-drawn bow down at the side so both limbs and string remain readable. No drawn arrow, forward lunging, hair flying in a combat vortex, foreshortening or dynamic camera angle. Ponytail, bow tips and both boots entirely inside frame with breathing room.
Consistent flat charcoal #202020 background; no scenery, floor line, particles, energy halo, UI, text, watermark, extra figure or multiple views. Shared ground baseline near 95% image height, adult female crown-to-soles about 82% of the canvas. One character, one front view only.

successful_recipes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE finished 2D anime fantasy-game MALE character, straight-on FRONT full body, portrait 2:3 preferably 1024x1536, matching an existing redesign set.

INPUT ROLES: 1 = ORIGINAL DESIGN COMPONENTS ONLY (blond armored man with white fur collar/red-lined cape). Extract hair, colors, costume and accessories; do not copy his individual face, original body ratios, sketchlike low-detail rendering, cropped view or hand-across-chest pose.
2 = Myst PRIMARY STYLE for male anime face simplification, fine linework, hair grouping and clean cel shading. Do not copy white hair, purple outfit or costume.
3 = Bram MATERIAL/STYLE for connected pale silver/ivory plate and restrained metal reflection. Do not import his blue accents or sword.
4 = FRONT COMPOSITION ONLY, neutral head-to-toes standing posture; do not copy this woman's gender/body/robe/hair.

KEEP DESIGN INVENTORY: short tousled golden-blond hair with a clearly visible saturated RED streak running through the front fringe and a small blond braid hanging forward at his right side. Red irises, but newly designed standard clean adult male anime facial geometry, composed confident expression rather than tracing the original smirk. Pale silver/white full plate cuirass, layered shoulders, segmented forearm guards and gauntlets, delicate gold borders and a few gold chest flourishes, gold-trimmed high neck armor. Deep red glove fabric visible between finger plates. Large white fur collar and white cloak with deep red lining, fine gold trim, red twisted cord and dark cross/clover-shaped clasp on his left shoulder. A broad muted-red hip belt/sash decorated with prominent gold sun medallions and small star motifs, pale armor skirt/tassets and muted-red fabric between them. Preserve the long narrow pale rectangular hanging belt accessory/scabbard silhouette at his right hip. Empty hands; do not add an unsheathed sword, staff or shield. Finish the cropped lower body with matching pale plate thighs, knees, shins and pointed armored boots using the same gold trim and red underlayer.

STANDARD MALE ANATOMY: tall adult male about 8 heads, broader shoulders and straighter torso than adult female models, lean strong build and long legs, normal hands. New male face using the target rendering language, simplified nose and mouth, clear upper eyelids. Standardize height and proportions rather than preserving source anatomy/personality.
Clean crisp tapered anime contours, coherent broad hair locks, feather/fur grouped into large pointed layers, big separated cel-shadow planes with limited soft gradients inside material planes. Subtle warm gold metal against cool white plate, matte dark red cloth, clean soft skin. No photo-realism, heavy hatching, flat unfinished sketch coloring, noisy microtexture or 3D gloss.

FRONT VIEW: shoulders, face, chest, hips, knees all square to camera, both feet planted, both arms lowered slightly away from torso and hands empty. Do not keep the crossed-up hand pose. Cloak naturally hangs behind and to the sides, fur and the red lining readable. Entire top hair tuft, braid, cloak tips, hands and both armored boots inside frame with margins. Flat dark charcoal #202020 background matching the set; no floor line, environment, glow, particles, text, watermark or extra people. Male crown-to-soles about 88% frame height, shared ground baseline near 95%, taller/broader read than female standard. One character and ONE view only.
